subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support these five global and per-agent memory role slots, including the new role-scoped plugin hook API and the proposed recall fallback semantics?
rationale: The change establishes durable public config and external plugin SDK contracts; implementation evidence cannot decide the permanent role taxonomy, lifecycle guarantees, fallback precedence, or compatibility window without owner intent.

options.title: Approve all five roles
options.body: Adopt the proposed taxonomy and per-agent overrides after fixing cross-surface resolution and completing final-head upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Ship only roles with complete invocation and UI semantics, deferring the remaining roles until their lifecycle protocols are defined.

options.title: Reject core role slots
options.body: Keep composition behind existing generic plugin seams or a narrower future API instead of adding this permanent core contract.

recommendation.title: Approve all five roles
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed taxonomy and per-agent overrides after fixing cross-surface resolution and completing final-head upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the broadest ownership signal across the affected plugin, config, memory runtime, and Control UI surfaces.
